response.original_title: The Colour of the Sky That Day
response.overview: A year after a devastating car crash, Lottie is still stuck in the moment everything changed, unable to drive or return to her old life. With her dad’s gentle encouragement, she finally sits behind the wheel, and memories of that day rush back, replaying the heavy, unfinished conversation with her sister, a moment she didn’t know would be their last. What begins as a simple drive with her dad becomes an act of courage, a small step toward the world waiting beyond her grief.
response.tagline: Paralysed by grief, a young woman must return to the driver’s seat and face the possibility of moving forward.
response.title: The Colour of the Sky That Day
